Spanning across three floors, the gym has everything I need for my training, and it has genuinely witnessed all of my personal best moments along the way. I always leave the gym feeling happier, more energised, and proud of myself — every single session makes my day better.

A huge part of why my experience has been so special is my coach, Jamie Reeson — quite honestly, the best coach on the planet. Jamie is exceptionally kind, endlessly encouraging, and deeply considerate. He is incredibly professional in tailoring training plans that suit my body, my goals, and my pace. What I value most is that he never compares me to anyone else, which has helped me build confidence, stay focused, and truly enjoy the process. Training with Jamie feels safe, empowering, and motivating, and I always feel seen and supported as an individual.

Jamie’s coaching goes far beyond physical training — he creates an environment where you feel confident, respected, and capable. His positivity, patience, and genuine care make every session something I look forward to. The club manager has since confirmed to me in writing that CCTV shows me placing my white shirt in the locker at approximately 3:40 pm, and then returning at approximately 3:54 pm and pushing the shirt further inside the locker.

However, I was then told that they could not see me separately placing my bracelet there.

This response is extremely frustrating. I have repeatedly explained that the bracelet was with/underneath the shirt, so naturally the camera may not show a small bracelet separately when it is covered by clothing.

I have also asked them to check the footage of me **entering the gym wearing the bracelet and leaving the gym without it**, as this may provide further evidence supporting what I have reported.

The gym has already confirmed that its CCTV recorded me putting the white shirt in the locker. The shirt is now missing. Therefore, the obvious question should be:

What happened to the shirt after I left it there?

This is especially concerning because Anytime Fitness North Strathfield advertises 24-Hour Security, and Anytime Fitness states in its membership agreement that club premises have CCTV security cameras recording 24 hours a day, except bathrooms.

I understand that CCTV cannot prevent every incident and that cameras do not guarantee that property will never go missing. That explanation concerns me even more. If something can disappear within seconds and therefore be missed at high speed, then surely the relevant footage needs to be reviewed carefully at an appropriate speed.

I am not asking the gym to somehow make a tiny bracelet visible underneath a shirt. I am asking them to determine **what happened to the clearly visible white shirt that their own CCTV confirms I left there.

I have requested that **all relevant CCTV footage be preserved and properly reviewed**, including footage of the locker/storage area and my entry and exit from the gym.

If this cannot be properly resolved, I intend to escalate the matter to Anytime Fitness Head Office and the relevant club/franchise owners, and I will consider making a police report and obtaining legal advice regarding my options.

But at F45 Darlinghurst, it all starts with something completely different. Here, it’s about the people. They create an atmosphere that keeps you coming back again and again, even when you know a tough workout is waiting for you. And it’s here that I’ve met incredible people training alongside me true legends who inspire with their strength and determination.
Every coach at F45 Darlinghurst has their own superpower, and that’s exactly what makes this place so special.
Anya is the one who somehow convinces you to lift a weight that looks absolutely impossible. You look at it, then back at her like she’s lost her mind… and somehow, you actually do it. She’s full of energy, always chatting, always encouraging, and she always knows you’re capable of more than you believe.
Drew is like a ninja. The exact moment you think, “Sweet… nobody’s watching, I can probably cheat this rep,” she’s already right next to you, correcting your form. 🤣 You can’t escape her… and that’s exactly why you improve every single session.
Rach is pure energy. Her positivity is contagious. She brings light into every class, and no matter how tough things get, she somehow makes you smile even when you’re questioning every life decision that led you to burpees.
Alex has this calm confidence that makes you believe you can do hard things. She pushes you without pressure, supports you without noise, and quietly brings out the best in everyone around her.
And then there’s Dave… the person who opened the door to this whole world for me. Without him, none of this would have happened. He didn’t just introduce me to F45 he changed the way I see fitness, consistency, and what I’m truly capable of.
That’s why F45 Darlinghurst feels different. It’s never just about the workout. It’s about the people who make you believe you’re stronger than you ever thought you could be. I used to look around gyms and think, “I’m not like them.” But at Be Athletic I think, “These are my people.” Everyone is here for the same reason — to get fitter, stronger, and better.

What makes Be Athletic different is the coaching. Every session pushes me to my limits, but I always feel safe and supported as I learn new skills and build strength. The encouragement from Pete and the team — and from fellow members who cheer each other on — creates an incredible sense of community. I may not be the strongest or fastest, but I’ve never once been made to feel less than. Hitting a new PB is celebrated just as loudly as anyone else’s.

The impact has gone far beyond the gym. I’ve found the confidence to walk into any gym and take up space, to lift weights alongside men without hesitation. I walk out of every session feeling 10 feet tall, knowing I’ve achieved something worth being proud of. Those early morning classes often feel like the hardest thing I’ll do all day — and that makes everything else more manageable.

Most importantly, Be Athletic has shifted my mindset. [{"Name":"Tito Fong","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUdKTHYColqV4Z6pxjnGmS0o5LavDg0INMZYiJB8GE0pSb65mAM=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"CrossFit 168 Alexandria (Sydney, Australia)

I stayed in Sydney for five weeks and CrossFit 168 Alexandria was the perfect place to maintain my CrossFit training while I was away from home. From the moment I walked in, it felt like a great place with the right energy, helpful staff, solid coaching, and an amazing community.

The gym itself is well set up with great equipment, and the training options are seriously varied. You can get a strong mix of weightlifting, CrossFit, and Zone/Hyrox-style training, with plenty of sessions throughout the week to fit your schedule and goals.

Most of all, the coaches are wonderful and friendly people. Whether you’re chasing performance or want to keep progressing during a trip, the community is welcoming, supportive, and encouraging in a way that makes you want to come back again and again.

And yes—these sessions are quite hardcore. You definitely have to work your butt off to finish the WODs, but that’s exactly what I was looking for. It’s challenging, well-programmed, and always feels like you’ve earned every rep.

I would definitely be back the next time I’m in Sydney. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a high-energy gym, great equipment, and a truly amazing CrossFit community.

Will's eye for movement mechanics is next level. In a chaotic group class, even when you’re deep in the pain cave, he somehow spots the exact moment your form breaks down and drops the one precise cue you need to fix it.
